summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new features: role-based form fields, grade override, announcements, stokis fee in payout, and validation rules. All backend and frontend tests passed successfully.

Backend: Admin Provinsi creation - sponsor/placement/stokis/PV correctly ignored and nullified
Backend: Stokis creation - only requires name, phone, province, city; network fields nullified
Backend: Member creation - sponsor validation (must be role=member, not admin/stokis)
Backend: PUT /api/members - role change to non-member clears sponsor/placement/stokis
Backend: POST /api/members/{id}/grade - set membership/rank without adding PV (admin_pusat only)
Backend: GET /api/grades - returns memberships and ranks arrays
Backend: GET /api/members/options?role=member - filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/members/options?role=stokis - filters correctly
Backend: POST /api/announcements - validation (title < 3 chars, empty body, invalid category)
Backend: Announcements CRUD - create, update, delete all working
Backend: GET /api/payout - includes total_payout_bv, total_payout_percent, stokis_fee.total_bv, company_bv
Backend: Payout formula - company_bv = omset.total - total_payout_bv verified
Backend: Bonus results only contain role=member (no admin/stokis in results)
Frontend: Login with ADMIN/admin123 successful
Frontend: /users page - Stokis role hides network/PV fields, shows province/city
Frontend: /users page - Admin Provinsi role shows province only, hides city
Frontend: Form validation - empty required fields show error messages
Frontend: /announcements page loads with create button for admin_pusat
Frontend: Dashboard widget 'Pengumuman Terbaru' present
Frontend: /payout page - Fee Stokis, Total Dikeluarkan cards, and formula visible
Frontend: All sidebar menus (Members, Network, Transactions, Products, Settings) load without errors
